Name: (CP) Zees Pride Shirts_Oddpodges Shirts_Shirtless Farmer_Content Patcher Conversion
Author: TheNewit13
Description:
[b][u]Before I begin, I would like to credit the following people for their work
[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Zee&[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/16649699]oddpodge[/url]﻿ for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2322]Zee's Pride Shirts Redux[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/16649699]oddpodge[/url] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1461]New Shirts With Fruits And LGBT Pride And More[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/39080835]Kaffeesatz[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/392/]JepMZ[/url]﻿ for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/667]Shirtless Farmer[/url]﻿
[*]A huge thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3604264]MouseyPounds[/url]﻿ for his guidance and help.
[/list]
Please go visit them and leave them Kudos and Endorsement.


[b]Introduction:[/b]
Celebrate your pride or run around Stardew shirtless with this Content Patcher conversion of the above three mods. No longer do you need to overwrite your shirts.xnb file or mess around trying to get different shirts mods to work. Just install SMAPI, Content Patcher and this mod and you are ready to go!

I also recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2348]Kisekae[/url]﻿, a modified version of Get Dressed mod that works with Stardew Valley 1.3 that allows you to change the appearance of your character whenever you wish! Perfect if you have already started a save game and would like to use this mod.

[b]Currently UNTESTED with multiplayer.[/b]


[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[/list]
[b]﻿Installing SMAPI[/b][b]
[list=1]
[*]See the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide]player's guide to modding[/url] (or skip to [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]install steps[/url])﻿. To update SMAPI, download the new version and run its installer; it'll clean up the old version automatically.

[/list][/b][list]
[/list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿

[b]Installing Content Patcher[/b]
[list=1]
[*][[url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].

[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

[*]Install any content packs you want by unzipping them into Stardew Valley/Mods.

[*]Run the game using SMAPI.

[/list]
Full information including help guides can be found on the mod pages.
